description: This file implements an HPACK encoder for HTTP/2 header compression, defining the Encoder struct and associated methods for encoding header fields, managing dynamic table size, and handling header table updates.

classes.name: Encoder
classes.description: A struct responsible for encoding HTTP/2 headers using HPACK, managing dynamic header table, and encoding header fields.

methods.name: NewEncoder
methods.description: Creates a new HPACK encoder that writes encoded data to the provided io.Writer.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Encodes a header field and writes it to the underlying writer, handling table size updates and indexing.

methods.name: searchTable
methods.description: Searches for a header field in static and dynamic header tables, returning the index and match type.

methods.name: SetMaxDynamicTableSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of the dynamic header table, updating the table size if within limits.

methods.name: MaxDynamicTableSize
methods.description: Returns the current maximum size of the dynamic header table.

methods.name: SetMaxDynamicTableSizeLimit
methods.description: Sets the upper limit for the dynamic header table size.

methods.name: shouldIndex
methods.description: Determines whether a header field should be indexed based on sensitivity and size.
